subject: Privacy-shielded visitor ops & credential escrow for C-suite field briefing
body:
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@acme.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tier1 Logistics <ops@tier1logistics.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Privacy-shielded visitor ops & credential escrow for C-suite field briefing

Rishi / Kimberly,

Thanks again for accommodating our board-level briefing on Nov 18. A couple of additional security/privacy asks from Acme Security:

- We need a privacy-shielded arrival and movement flow for three C-suite guests (no photos/badges visible in public areas).
- Temporary badges should be issued but held in credential-escrow (locked pouch at reception) until guests are escorted directly to the briefing room.
- Minimal disclosure: reception should only see guest names and escort ID; no department tagging on the badge.
- Escort plan: two dedicated escorts from Redwood while on site; handoff to Acme security only inside the suite.
- NDA requirement: guests will sign the NDA on-site; we will provide a pre-signed template if helpful.

Can you confirm Redwood’s operational flow and that your staff can support the escrow pouch and a private check-in lane? Attached: provisional guest manifest and a redacted site map.

Emily
Emily Carter
Head of Physical Security
Acme Financial
[attachment: visitor_manifest.csv (csv, 9KB)] [attachment: site_map_private.pdf (pdf, 420KB)]

---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Emily Carter <emily.carter@acme.com>, Tier1 Logistics <ops@tier1logistics.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Privacy-shielded visitor ops & credential escrow for C-suite field briefing

Thanks Emily — we can support this, want to outline a concise ops plan so everyone is clear. High level:

1) Arrival & credential escrow
   - Reception will allocate a locked pouch (segregated key) for "escrow badges"; pouch held by Security Lead (Kim) until verified handoff.
   - Badges will be printed with a generic title ("Guest") and an internal escort ID only; no company or department text.

2) Private check-in lane
   - We’ll reserve the inward-facing lane at the north vestibule for 30 minutes starting 08:40 on Nov 18. Tier1 will set up a privacy screen to prevent badge/ID photos.

3) Escort & handoff
   - Redwood escorts: Marcus and one backup (on-call) will meet guests inside the vestibule, escort to briefing room via secure corridor.
   - Acme security will only meet inside the suite post-briefing if necessary.

4) NDAs & minimal disclosure
   - We can host NDA signing at a private table adjacent to the briefing room; scanned copy uploaded to your secure folder if you want.

5) Comms & escalation
   - Primary comms channel: radio channel RED-OPS-3 and backup via secure cell.
   - If any credential discrepancy: receptionist escalates to Security Lead and holds badge in pouch.

Please see the attached draft procedure for credential escrow and the proposed timeline. Kimberly — can you confirm staffing and confirm the pouch key custodian? Marcus — please confirm escort staffing and radio check.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Partnerships (on-site ops lead)
Redwood Inference
[attachment: credential_escrow-procedure.docx (docx, 68KB)]

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Emily Carter <emily.carter@acme.com>, Tier1 Logistics <ops@tier1logistics.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Privacy-shielded visitor ops & credential escrow for C-suite field briefing

All set on staffing. Quick notes / additions:

- Reception staffing: We’ll have two receptionists on duty; one will be dedicated to the private lane and trained on the minimal disclosure script.
- Pouch custody: I’ll be the key custodian on-site; key will remain with me except during the escorted handoff.
- Badge printing: We’ll pre-print blank badges with 'Guest' and escort ID; we’ll affix a tamper-evident sticker after print.
- Attachment: visitor_manifest.csv (includes arrival ETA and clearance level).

Logistics ask for Acme: please confirm guest arrival windows (+/- 10 minutes) so we can minimize public exposure.

Kimberly Park
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: visitor_manifest.csv (csv, 5KB)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Emily Carter <emily.carter@acme.com>, Tier1 Logistics <ops@tier1logistics.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Privacy-shielded visitor ops & credential escrow for C-suite field briefing

Adding a couple operational checks from the ops playbook:

- Radio/drill: Marcus — please run an on-site radio check at 07:30 on Nov 18 (channel RED-OPS-3). Confirm with Tier1 that their operator is monitoring the same channel.
- Camera covers: Security — we’ll mask any public-facing feeds in the vestibule for the arrival window; notify SOC so logs are annotated.
- Visitor logs: We will create a redacted visitor log (names + escort ID only) and store it under the Acme secure folder with 30-day retention.

Also recommend runner protocol for materials so guests don't pass through open areas holding documents; Marcus, can you assign one runner to carry briefing packs in a closed pouch?

Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Customer Events & Experience
Redwood Inference

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Carter <emily.carter@acme.com>, Tier1 Logistics <ops@tier1logistics.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 22:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Privacy-shielded visitor ops & credential escrow for C-suite field briefing

Confirmed on escorts and runner. Quick checklist for D-day:

- 08:10: Reception sets up privacy screen at north vestibule.
- 08:20: Tier1 positions kiosk + radio check with RED-OPS-3.
- 08:30: Marcus & backup on site, runner assigned, pouch pre-staged with empty tamper-evident bag.
- 08:40: Guests arrive; reception prints and deposits badges into pouch; Kimberly holds key.
- 08:45: Marcus escorts guests via secure corridor to briefing room; runner delivers briefing packs in sealed pouch.
- 09:30: Post-briefing: badges collected and returned to pouch; Acme security collects when handoff agreed.

If no objections I’ll lock this schedule in and send the final one-page ops card to all parties and to Reception for pre-brief.

Marcus Lin
Events & Field Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
